spells/local-tremor-3096.name: Local Tremor
spells/local-tremor-3096.effectSummary: Creates directed 30-foot-line tremors through the ground. When you finish casting and as often as once per round afterward, you can produce a tremor starting at your location in a direction you choose, up to a total number equal to your caster level (maximum five). A creature standing in the line must succeed on a Reflex save or fall prone. A spellcaster standing in an affected square must also make a Concentration check with DC 20 + the spell level or lose any spell being attempted. You do not have to create a tremor immediately and can take other actions or cast other spells between tremors. Producing a later tremor requires a standard action. The spell lasts 1 minute per caster level or until all available tremors are expended, whichever comes first.
